title: feat(leaf-ton/rss-catalysts): live RSS/Atom feed verification & catalyst scoring for TON
lane_reason: Scoped ecosystem RSS verification and catalyst scoring for leaf-ton in backend/tools/rss_tools.py + tests

escalation.detail: R3 approved f0a6981. The branch was then rebased onto master after PR #205 (BNB RSS) merged; the TON block moved from after the XRP anchor to after the BNB anchor. Content is byte-identical (score_ton_catalyst, verify_and_ingest_ton_feeds, test_ton_rss compared before/after), but refresh-sha refuses because git patch-id changes when an added block moves relative to sibling blocks. A fourth review round is forbidden by the 3-round cap. Human decision needed: accept the position-only rebase (merge at 309a14a) or re-review. Tooling follow-up: patch-id should compare added-line content, not its position among sibling hunks.
